t: This is a bronze statue of George Washington, cast in London from a work by the French neoclassical sculptor Jean-Antoine Houdon. Washington was the first president of the United States, serving from 1789 to 1797. As commander of the Continental Army he led Patriot forces to victory in the American Revolutionary War against the British Empire, which is why he is known as the Father of His Country. It's a curious thing to find him standing in bronze in the capital of the empire he defeated.
